answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, re-queued for a second panel, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Each submission hangs on the ocean of a task receipt, and the marble is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Reaching the haven of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
